note: Alberta Parks campground on the Bow River, about 2 km east and 2 km south of Carseland on Hwy 24, run by MIM Management Group: shaded sites under mature cottonwoods, many just steps from the river and the river pathway. Boat launch, playground and wall tents. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (Jun 5, 2026) + shop read: C$31 unserviced and season May 15 - Oct 12 confirmed; sites ~200 -> 164, max 61 ft; reservable 90 days on the shop; vault toilets, seasonal tap water, coin sani-dump. Riverview kept. Phone 403-934-3523 found; the vault-toilet construction note (through May 2026) dropped as past.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverview - kept): the page says 'Many sites are just steps from the Bow River and the scenic river pathway, providing easy access for evening strolls and beautiful views.' The shop tags no site 'Near Water'. On imagery the three loops fill a 1.2 km strip of cottonwoods on the south bank; the north loop road runs along the bank about 20-40 m from the water, and the sites inside it sit ~40-70 m back, with the loop road, the river pathway and a band of shrubs/trees between them and the river (open patches in places). Water within ~70 m and partly open ground: riverview. Not riverfront (the campground's own loop road lies between every site and the river).

PHONE (stored empty): recommend 403-934-3523 (page 'Information: 403-934-3523'). Facility Operator: 'MIM Management Group Ltd.' Seniors line PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.'). WEBSITES: both stored URLs answered 200 and are this campground.
SITE LENGTH: Loop A sites 51 and 16/17 are 20 ft and 19/20, 21/22 are 21 ft; all other listings 31-61 ft.
NOTE: dropped 'Vault-toilet replacement construction through end of May 2026' (the current page carries no advisory; the date is past).

PIN (50.83050,-113.42680): on the campground's access road along the south edge of the eastern loops; the page's directions point 50.831817,-113.432258 is in the western loops (~410 m apart). Both are inside the 1.2 km campground; no move needed (reviewer may prefer the page's point).
